title: Task contract
description: One unit of work: what goes out to the session (task) and what comes back (result). Shared by claude-master (the map between sessions: plan, plan run, task registry) and fable-director (the loop inside a node: budget-open --verify, telemetry). Copied, never imported, into both repos; a test in each checks the copies are identical. A change bumps schema_version.

task.description: The outbound half. Every field is required: a task without a check, a perimeter or a lane is not a task.

type.description: Task category slug; it becomes fable-director's budget-open --type, which links the node to the reliability of its type.

plan.description: The approved plan this task belongs to (its id), or null for a task outside any plan. Approving the plan approves push, release and publication of its tasks, except those with hold true.

project.description: Absolute path of the folder the task works in.

session.description: Name of the session that runs it, or null: plan run opens one.

account.description: Account name as in claude-master's config, or null: deduced from the folder.

check.description: A command that can fail: exit 0 = green. It becomes fable-director's budget-open --verify inside the node, and the registry reruns it before marking the task done. Fake checks (true, echo, a pipe into tail, || true, grep -c without a comparison) are refused by fable-director's verify-lint. Inside the node fable-director's Stop hook runs it with a 60 s limit (FD_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_S): a longer check is rerun only by the registry, with timeout_s.

cwd.description: Folder to run it in; null = where.project.

perimeter.description: Globs the task may write, relative to where.project. It becomes budget-open --paths; [] = declared read-only (review, research), --paths none.

lane.description: Set by the possible damage, not by the model's confidence. open: local commits, tests, docs. wide: shared code (relay, kernel, hooks, marketplace), deterministic checks plus a review before merging. closed: push, release, publication, public posts, client texts, production writes, deletions; it opens only for a task of an approved plan without hold, or with a recorded ok.

depends_on.description: Only tasks whose output really enters this one, each naming what passes. If nothing can be named, there is no edge and the tasks run in parallel.

route.description: How plan run executes the node, from fable-director's routing when present. script: plan run runs check-only work itself, no session. cheap: a session that hands the mechanical part to a cheap executor. session: a session on the top model. win: a session on the win host.

run.description: route script only: the command plan run executes in where.project (no session); the check then decides.

hold.description: true = «do not publish yet»: the closed lane stays shut even inside an approved plan.

attempts_max.description: Retries of this unit only, never of the batch; past it the task goes to the person.

data_class.description: As fable-director's --data-class: restricted never leaves the machine.

constraints.description: Constraints the registry attached from earlier tasks of the same project or topic (the learning edge).

result.description: The return half. No free-text tables: outcome, reason, proof.

value.description: The command with its exit code and last lines, the commit hash, or the URL.

perimeter.description: On red: the narrowed perimeter for the retry (the files to fix).

measures.description: Written by fable-director's telemetry when it is installed and active; absent otherwise. claude-master reads, never writes these.

verify_rc.description: Exit code of the --verify run by fable-director's Stop hook, or its error text.

reliability.description: fable-director's reliability of the task type; plan run may use it to pick the route or ask for an adversarial verify on fragile types.
